name: MATH (Competition Mathematics)
description: A benchmark of 12,500 challenging competition mathematics problems from AMC, AIME, HMMT, and other competitions, spanning 7 difficulty levels and 7 subject areas: prealgebra, algebra, number theory, counting/probability, geometry, intermediate algebra, and precalculus.
reputation: Standard competition math benchmark; introduced by Hendrycks et al.; superseded GSM8K for harder math evaluation; MATH-500 subset widely used
notes: Also known as the Hendrycks MATH benchmark. Problems span difficulty levels 1-5 within 7 math subjects. MATH-500 is a 500-problem subset used for faster evaluation. Near-saturated by top frontier models as of 2025.
